board.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / UI icon art direction review board.
Create ONE carefully art-directed wide landscape design review board for an original cheerful Roblox desert mining simulator named “+1矿工”. This is an icon FAMILY CONCEPT SHEET for human approval, not a game screenshot, not an atlas, and not final production sprites.
Reference image: approved cartoon pickaxe ONLY for brush/render style: chunky friendly silhouette, clean near-black navy contour, large blue-silver metal planes, amber wood, small controlled highlights, upper-left light, almost no microtexture. Do not reproduce another game's UI or muscle-arm / money-bundle icons.
Board background warm off-white. Elegant minimal tiny Chinese headings, no decorative panels. One coherent family, no rainbow childish toy feeling.
Top heading exactly “矿工 HUD · 图标试稿”.
Main area: TWELVE large distinct standalone icons, evenly spaced in a four-column by three-row grid with small dark clear Chinese labels BELOW icons; each icon fills similar visible bounds and would read at 64px. No button backgrounds, no UI currency price badges.
Row1 labels and subjects:
“矿工背包”: burnt-orange canvas mining backpack with teal rolled top, wide cream clasp, two large seams, no face.
“矿纹金币 A”: two offset chunky hexagonal GOLD COINS, one has a simple original stylized rock-cut mark embossed on it, no dollar sign, no banknote bundle.
“重生”: a warm glowing miner lantern inside one open turquoise circular arrow, clear empty negative space, no clock.
“商店”: open timber supply crate with a helmet and one small price tag.
Row2:
“幸运轮”: a chunky eight-segment mining-wheel disc with one cyan pointer at top, amber/teal/cream segments, no casino text.
“铁镐”: the approved blue-silver pickaxe style from the reference, dominant asymmetrical large head and amber handle.
“强化”: steel anvil with a single short bold upward amber arrow behind it.
“矿石图鉴”: thick teal field notebook with corner tabs and a gold geometric mineral mark on cover, two mineral chips beside it.
Row3:
“挂机”: a folded camp stool and miner lantern, extremely simple silhouette, no sleepy face.
“好友”: two overlapping miner helmets, amber foreground and teal background, friendly silhouette without characters or faces.
“双倍力量”: TWO separated compact pickaxes with a simple white “×2” small badge, do not use an arm.
“矿纹金锭 B”: three chunky gold ingots, one diagonal chiseled mineral seam mark, an ALTERNATIVE currency icon to A.
Footer tiny exact Chinese “同一套粗描边 · 大色块 · 小尺寸识别” and “金币 A / 金锭 B 待选”.
Icons must feel hand-directed polished game icon illustration, not photoreal, not ornate, no random sparkles, no excessive gloss, no external logos. Crisp contours and no cropped objects. Choose readable Chinese lettering. Do not include the original reference PNG itself as a separate sample.

layout.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity 16:9 landscape GAME HUD VISUAL PROTOTYPE, full-bleed game screen, for our original Roblox desert mining game “+1矿工”. This is a DRAFT with demonstration numbers, NOT a claim of a working game.
Input image 1 = our real game screenshot for WORLD IDENTITY ONLY: preserve its orange desert canyon, pale stone cross-shaped courtyard paths, training stones on left, small wooden stalls by center, mine entrance ahead, third-person Roblox player. Remove its existing dark HUD panels, remove giant floating world title obscuring the player's head, and remove the enlarged +1 popup. Do NOT upgrade the world to a fantasy illustration or invent lush lawns; keep a simple believable Roblox world with extra horizontal view framing to fit 16:9. The HUD should be crisp and much more finished than the intentionally simple world.
Input image 2 = original mining icon family concept board. Use EXACT family identity and silhouettes for backpack, ore-stamped hex gold coins A, circular miner-lantern rebirth, supply crate store, mining lucky wheel, blue-silver pickaxe, anvil upgrade, teal field guide, camp stool+lantern AFK, two helmets friends, twin pickaxes ×2. Do NOT reproduce or embed the concept board. These are UI icons at game scale.
Primary goal: practical BUILDABLE Roblox UI, cheerful chunky 2D game illustrations, large clean white Chinese text with restrained near-black outline, clean simple 2D panel shapes and one-color borders. Avoid fantastical carved gold frames, 3D wood boards, filigree, glossy bubbles everywhere. Use warm amber, deep slate navy, cyan/teal accent and off-white. Buttons are flat beveled clipped-corner tiles with a single ink border and a narrow shadow; these can be native Frames plus icons. No copied arm/muscle icon, dollar bundle, original competitor's color/block treatment.
LAYOUT:
Leave central 65 percent of the screen and lower center playable view EMPTY, player and ground visible.
TOP center, inset from top Roblox controls: a compact badge “等级 4” attached to a broad but NOT screen-spanning progress bar. Amber fill about 85 percent, slate empty track, clear white “58 / 68” inside; small readable sublabel directly below “还差 10 升级”. Total top bar width about 50 percent of screen, height 64px at 1600 reference width. To its RIGHT a clearly separate compact offer button with TWO pickaxes and big “×2”, label “双倍力量”, price exact “R$ 9”. No arm art.
LEFT middle: eight square menu buttons in two columns x four rows, about 66px each at 1600 wide. Each has ONE big icon above and clear short label below within tile. Labels row order “商店”“幸运轮”; “铁镐”“强化”; “重生”“图鉴”; “挂机”“好友”. Group color roles: teal/steel, amber for store only, lavender ONLY rebirth if needed. Do not make all saturated cyan like competitor. No red notification badges.
BOTTOM LEFT: three stacked SIMPLE resource rows over subtle slate backing strips (no large dashboard panel). Large original mining backpack + bold white “2 / 5”; gold hex coins A + warm gold “1,280”; cyan circular miner lantern + white “0”. Tiny labels “背包”, “金币”, “重生” allowed but prioritize numbers.
RIGHT edge middle, not touching top button: THREE compact vertically stacked POWER PACKAGE OFFER TILES. Each icon is an increasingly chunky blue-silver pickaxe with one orange upward impact streak, never flexing arm, never crystals. Clear exact labels from top to bottom:
“+150 力量” / “R$ 15”
“+600 力量” / “R$ 49”
“+1,500 力量” / “R$ 79”
Price appears in a small green-blue flat inset button, not a fake Roblox currency icon. Space packages sufficiently; do not span full screen height. These are sample balances only.
BOTTOM RIGHT: small tasteful unobtrusive badge exact “UI 视觉稿 · 数值与价格待定”.
NO leaderboard overlay, NO huge game title, NO inventory hotbar, NO tutorial banner, NO extra copy, NO explanatory arrows or margins, NO phone frame. At most tiny standard Roblox corner controls in top-left. All Chinese labels must be accurate. Everything readable at thumbnail. UI should feel cute and bold, not babyish or plastic. Strong contrast, thoughtful spacing, no overly complex decoration.
